name: Canonical task creation
requirement: The system shall create tasks through Hawa Desk and adapter events without making any chat platform authoritative.

name: Raw event retention
requirement: The system shall preserve the normalized source event, source identifier, edit history, attachments, and thread context according to retention policy.

name: Webhook verification
requirement: Each adapter shall authenticate incoming events using the strongest source-supported mechanism before persistence.

name: Event idempotency
requirement: A repeated source event shall produce exactly one logical message event and no more than one task.

name: Task promotion
requirement: Passive messages shall become production tasks only through an explicit command, mention, reaction, Hawa Desk action, or approved classifier policy.

name: Manual intake
requirement: Authorized users shall create tasks directly in Hawa Desk with files, exact copy, dimensions, due date, and client/project selection.

name: Client channel mapping
requirement: The system shall support versioned mappings from channel, group, topic, sender, alias, and campaign code to allowed clients/projects.

name: Deterministic routing first
requirement: Client/project resolution shall apply deterministic evidence before model classification.

name: Candidate-limited AI routing
requirement: The routing model shall receive only clients/projects permitted for the source context.

name: Ambiguity gate
requirement: Conflicting or sub-threshold routing shall pause and require an authorized human selection.

name: Scope lock
requirement: The selected tenant/client scope shall be immutable for a generation attempt and established before retrieval.

name: Wrong-client correction
requirement: An authorized reviewer shall correct routing; downstream artifacts shall be invalidated and safely regenerated within the new scope.

name: Design brief schema
requirement: The system shall produce a schema-valid Design Brief containing exact copy, locale, direction, format, requirements, assets, constraints, risks, and missing facts.

name: No invented facts
requirement: The system shall never invent names, dates, prices, contacts, locations, legal claims, dimensions, or official slogans.

name: Exact-copy lock
requirement: User- or client-approved copy shall be stored separately from model suggestions and compared byte/normalization-aware before approval.

name: Task route selection
requirement: The system shall route work to template fill, editable AI composition, novel Creative Director workflow, or human-only design.

name: Client DNA
requirement: Each client shall have versioned authoritative brand identity, language rules, assets, templates, permissions, folder mappings, approval policy, and prohibited elements.

name: Knowledge ingestion
requirement: Authorized documents and visual examples shall be parsed, versioned, hashed, and indexed with provenance.

name: Curated ingestion scope
requirement: Only explicitly approved client knowledge locations and files shall be indexed.

name: Hybrid retrieval
requirement: Retrieval shall combine structured truth, exact/glossary search, PostgreSQL full-text/trigram search, multimodal embeddings, and reranking.

name: Client-first retrieval filter
requirement: Every retrieval query shall enforce tenant/client and approval/version filters before similarity ranking.

name: Positive/negative separation
requirement: Approved examples may be positive references; rejected designs shall be negative-only and include reasons.

name: Retrieval evidence
requirement: Every Design Plan shall cite the exact rules, assets, examples, and feedback records used.

name: Private composition reference
requirement: Novel designs may generate one private art-direction reference whose pixels shall never enter the shipped artifact.

name: Asset architecture
requirement: The Creative Director shall select slot matrix, modular field, continuous scene, cutout stack, or layered collage before asset generation.

name: Independent visual assets
requirement: Replaceable visual roles shall be generated or imported as independent assets when doing so preserves editability and quality.

name: Approved logos only
requirement: Official logos shall be selected by immutable asset ID/hash and shall never be recreated by an image model.

name: Editable source
requirement: Every automated graphic shall retain an editable structured source document with live text and independently addressable nodes.

name: Canonical creative document
requirement: The accepted studio document and its content hash shall be the authoritative creative structure for a revision.

name: Studio adapter
requirement: All business operations shall access the design engine through a versioned adapter contract.

name: Local edit preservation
requirement: A user shall modify one text, image, color, crop, or layout node without regenerating unrelated content.

name: Design versioning
requirement: Every saved revision shall create an immutable version record and preserve parent/child relationships.

name: Multi-format variants
requirement: The system shall generate required aspect ratios as linked variants while preserving explicit per-variant overrides.

name: Sorani support
requirement: The editor, renderer, QA, and review flow shall support Central Kurdish/Sorani script, punctuation, digits, fonts, and mixed-direction text.

name: Arabic support
requirement: The editor, renderer, QA, and review flow shall support Arabic shaping, direction, punctuation, digits, and mixed Latin segments.

name: Language metadata
requirement: Every text node shall carry locale, direction, canonical copy reference, and normalization policy.

name: Font management
requirement: Authorized users shall upload/version client fonts; the system shall validate licensing metadata and glyph coverage.

name: Deterministic render QA
requirement: The system shall validate schema, dimensions, file integrity, text overflow, clipping, glyphs, bidi behavior, safe zones, approved assets, and package completeness.

name: Visual QA
requirement: An independent vision model shall score a fixed rubric and return evidence-linked findings without overriding hard checks.

name: Bounded repair
requirement: Automatic repair shall run no more than two times per failed candidate unless a human explicitly authorizes another attempt.

name: Human review
requirement: Reviewers shall inspect full-size output, exact copy, references, QA evidence, and revision differences before approval.

name: Structured revision
requirement: A revision request shall identify scope, category, target nodes, priority, and whether the feedback is one-time or reusable.

name: Approval authority
requirement: Only users with the configured client/project role may approve or reject a design.

name: Approval immutability
requirement: Approval records shall be append-only and bound to an exact design/artifact hash.

name: Publication package
requirement: Approval shall produce final formats, editable source, assets, brief, design plan, QC report, provenance, and approval manifest.

name: Deterministic Drive destination
requirement: Drive IDs shall come from Client DNA; models shall not search for or choose destination folders.

name: Idempotent Drive upload
requirement: A retry shall reuse or verify existing files by task/revision/output/content hash rather than create duplicates.

name: Publication verification
requirement: The publisher shall read back file IDs, sizes, checksums/metadata, and permissions before marking completion.

name: Sheets upsert
requirement: The reporting sheet shall be updated by immutable task ID and stored row identity, never blind-appended on retries.

name: Publication reconciliation
requirement: A scheduled process shall compare PostgreSQL, Drive, and Sheet state and repair or flag divergence.

name: Thread notification
requirement: The originating adapter shall receive status and final links when permitted; notification failure shall not roll back publication.

name: Feedback ledger
requirement: Every correction, approval, rejection, and manual edit shall become a structured feedback event.

name: Rule proposals
requirement: Repeated or explicit corrections may create scoped candidate rules with supporting evidence.

name: Rule governance
requirement: Only authorized humans may activate, retire, or supersede a Client DNA rule.

name: Evaluation-case creation
requirement: Important failures and accepted edge cases shall be promotable into regression datasets.

name: Model registry
requirement: All model roles shall resolve through a versioned registry containing exact model ID, provider, parameters, limits, cost, policy, and evaluation status.

name: Model admission
requirement: A model/prompt/tool change shall not become primary until it passes the defined offline evaluation and canary gates.

name: Model fallback
requirement: Each critical model role shall have an evaluated fallback with explicitly allowed degradation.

name: Provider outage handling
requirement: Provider failures shall pause, retry, fall back according to policy, or request human action without losing completed work.

name: Workflow recovery
requirement: Every long-running task shall resume after worker/server restart without repeating completed non-idempotent side effects.

name: Manual workflow control
requirement: Operators shall pause, resume, cancel, replay, or restart from an approved checkpoint with an audit reason.

name: Capacity control
requirement: The system shall limit expensive model, GPU, render, and publication concurrency by office/client/task scope.

name: Operational inbox
requirement: Hawa Desk shall show new, blocked, generating, review, failed, publishing, and completed tasks with actionable reasons.

name: Operations evidence
requirement: A failed step shall expose sanitized inputs, outputs, attempts, error class, next safe action, and trace link.

name: AI tracing
requirement: Every AI call shall record role, exact model, prompt version, tool/schema version, token/asset cost, latency, and trace ID.

name: Data minimization
requirement: Only the minimum client context required by a model call shall leave the office, subject to client egress policy.

name: Local-only policy
requirement: A client/project may prohibit all external model calls and route to local models or humans.

name: Prompt-injection boundary
requirement: Message/document instructions shall not alter permissions, system policies, tools, client scope, publication destination, or approval.

name: Audit trail
requirement: Security- and business-relevant actions shall be append-only, attributable, timestamped, and queryable.

name: Backup and restore
requirement: The system shall create encrypted backups and prove restoration on a clean environment at the defined cadence.

name: Adapter health
requirement: The system shall monitor sequence gaps, authentication state, webhook health, and last successful reconciliation per adapter.

name: WhatsApp isolation
requirement: WAHA shall run under a dedicated account and network/service boundary with a kill switch and no authoritative state.

name: ComfyUI isolation
requirement: Only allowlisted, pinned, scanned ComfyUI nodes/workflows shall execute; workers shall not receive office database credentials.

name: Upstream pinning
requirement: Editors, workflows, model weights, and critical containers shall be pinned by immutable version/digest and upgraded only through compatibility testing.

name: Studio fallback export
requirement: The system shall retain enough neutral manifest data and standard exports to migrate a design away from the selected studio.

name: Accessibility
requirement: Hawa Desk shall support keyboard navigation, visible focus, sufficient contrast, semantic status, and reduced motion.

name: Search and history
requirement: Authorized users shall search tasks, clients, copy, assets, feedback, and revisions without leaking other clients.

name: Office configuration
requirement: Admins shall configure clients, projects, adapters, roles, model policies, folders, templates, and review gates without code changes.

name: Cost controls
requirement: The system shall enforce per-role budgets, generation caps, and visible estimated/actual cost before expensive reruns.

name: Safe deletion
requirement: Destructive actions shall use retention-aware soft deletion and preserve audit; permanent purge requires explicit privileged workflow.

name: Reliability
requirement: No acknowledged task event may be silently lost. Event processing is at-least-once with logical exactly-once effects.

name: Availability
requirement: Core office intake and review target 99.5% monthly availability on supported infrastructure; adapters may have lower independent availability.

name: Recovery
requirement: Target database RPO ≤15 minutes and core RTO ≤4 hours; restore drills must prove these targets.

name: Performance
requirement: P95 Hawa Desk task list ≤1.5 s on office network; P95 webhook acknowledgement ≤1 s; non-AI state transitions ≤2 s.

name: Scalability
requirement: Support 100 active clients, 100,000 tasks, 2 million knowledge chunks, 25 concurrent office users, and controlled GPU/API queues without architecture change.

name: Security
requirement: Least privilege, client isolation, encrypted transport, server-side secrets, protected admin interfaces, and auditable authorization are mandatory.

name: Privacy
requirement: Per-client retention and model-egress policy shall be enforceable and testable.

name: Editability
requirement: 100% of automated production designs shall have a valid editable source; flattened-only output is a blocked failure.

name: Multilingual correctness
requirement: All critical Sorani/Arabic golden cases shall pass exact-copy and native-speaker visual review before release.

name: Portability
requirement: Operational data exports to documented JSON/CSV/SQL; designs export as `.hyc` plus standard SVG/PDF/PNG and a source manifest.

name: Observability
requirement: Every task shall be traceable across ingress, workflow, retrieval, model, studio, QA, approval, and publication.

name: Maintainability
requirement: Core business logic shall be covered by unit/contract tests and kept independent of specific adapters, models, and editors.

name: Upgrade safety
requirement: No production dependency auto-updates; upgrades require backup, compatibility suite, canary, and rollback artifact.

name: Determinism
requirement: Given the same approved inputs and pinned deterministic steps, routing, validation, filenames, and publication identities shall be repeatable.

name: Auditability
requirement: Approvals, rule changes, permissions, publications, and operator interventions shall be immutable and attributable.

name: Usability
requirement: A trained office operator shall create, route, review, revise, and publish routine work without command-line access.

name: Failure clarity
requirement: Every blocked/failed task shall expose a human-readable cause and one safe next action.

name: Cost efficiency
requirement: Routine template tasks shall avoid image generation and deep models when deterministic operations satisfy requirements.

name: Vendor independence
requirement: Failure or retirement of one model/provider, messaging adapter, or studio shall not require rewriting business state or workflow.

name: Data integrity
requirement: Foreign keys, constraints, hashes, append-only ledgers, and reconciliation protect against plausible-but-wrong state.

name: Accessibility
requirement: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for the Hawa Desk operational UI.

name: Internationalization
requirement: UI strings and content metadata support English, Central Kurdish (`ckb`), and Arabic (`ar`) with direction isolation.

name: Deployment simplicity
requirement: The base office deployment runs on one protected server plus optional GPU worker; Kubernetes is not required.

name: Testability
requirement: All third-party adapters have contract fakes and deterministic fixtures; model quality is tested separately from workflow correctness.

name: Evidence discipline
requirement: Claims about third-party capabilities remain conditional until executable admission tests pass.
